title: Corpus drift: cached aggregator HTML whose <title> mismatches its filename showId (baseline-diff)
description:
check-corpus-drift.js audit "aggregator-archive-integrity" (node scripts/audit-aggregator-archive-integrity.js --strict) has been drifting. Latest output:

Aggregator-archive integrity:
  Scanned: 6240 files
  Skipped (no show in shows.json): 266
  Bad: 1

❌ NEW bad archives (1):
   - bww-roundups/richard-ii-off-west-end-2026

Each represents a cached aggregator HTML file whose page title
does not match the showId in the filename — i.e., poisoned cache.

Remediate by re-fetching or quarantining the file, then re-running
the audit. To accept these intentionally, run --update-baseline.
